verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ יוֹנָ֥ה בֶן־ אֲמִתַּ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yō·w·nāh ḇen- ’ă·mit·tay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah son of Amittai saying
verses.literalPt: A palavra de Jeová veio a Jonas, filho de Amitai, dizendo:

verses.original: ק֠וּם לֵ֧ךְ אֶל־ נִֽינְוֵ֛ה הָעִ֥יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה וּקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּֽי־ עָלְתָ֥ה רָעָתָ֖ם לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: qūm lêḵ ’el- nî·nə·wêh hā·‘îr hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ū·qə·rā ‘ā·le·hā kî- ‘ā·lə·ṯāh rā·‘ā·ṯām lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: Get up Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it because its wickedness has come up before Me
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, vai à grande cidade de Nínive e clama contra ela, porque a sua malícia subiu à minha presença.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קָם יוֹנָה֙ לִבְרֹ֣חַ תַּרְשִׁ֔ישָׁה מִלִּפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֨רֶד יָפ֜וֹ וַיִּמְצָ֥א אָנִיָּ֣ה׀ בָּאָ֣ה תַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שְׂכָרָ֜הּ וַיֵּ֤רֶד בָּהּ֙ לָב֤וֹא עִמָּהֶם֙ תַּרְשִׁ֔ישָׁה מִלִּפְנֵ֖י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām yō·w·nāh liḇ·rō·aḥ tar·šî·šāh mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yê·reḏ yā·p̄ōw way·yim·ṣā ʾå̄·nī·yå̄h bā·’āh ṯar·šîš way·yit·tên śə·ḵā·rāh way·yê·reḏ bāh lā·ḇō·w ‘im·mā·hem tar·šî·šāh mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Jonah, however got up to flee to Tarshish away from the presence of the LORD He went down to Joppa and found a ship bound for Tarshish So he paid the fare and went aboard . . . to sail . . . for Tarshish away from the presence of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Jonas, porém, levantou-se para fugir da presença de Jeová, para Társis. Desceu a Jope e achou um navio que ia para Társis; pagou, pois, a sua passagem e embarcou nele para ir com eles a Társis da presença de Jeová.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֗ה הֵטִ֤יל רֽוּחַ־ גְּדוֹלָה֙ אֶל־ הַיָּ֔ם וַיְהִ֥י סַֽעַר־ גָּד֖וֹל בַּיָּ֑ם וְהָ֣אֳנִיָּ֔ה חִשְּׁבָ֖ה לְהִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hê·ṭîl rū·aḥ- gə·ḏō·w·lāh ’el- hay·yām way·hî sa·‘ar- gā·ḏō·wl bay·yām wə·hā·’o·nî·yāh ḥiš·šə·ḇāh lə·hiš·šā·ḇêr
verses.literal: Then the LORD hurled a great wind upon the sea and such a violent storm arose that the ship was in danger of breaking apart
verses.literalPt: Mas Jeová lançou no mar um grande vento, e fez-se no mar uma grande tempestade, de sorte que o navio estava em perigo de se fazer em pedaços.

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֣וּ הַמַּלָּחִ֗ים וַֽיִּזְעֲקוּ֮ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ אֱלֹהָיו֒ וַיָּטִ֨לוּ אֶת־ הַכֵּלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּֽאֳנִיָּה֙ אֶל־ הַיָּ֔ם לְהָקֵ֖ל מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְיוֹנָ֗ה יָרַד֙ אֶל־ יַרְכְּתֵ֣י הַסְּפִינָ֔ה וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב וַיֵּרָדַֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rə·’ū ham·mal·lā·ḥîm way·yiz·‘ă·qū ’îš ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hāw way·yā·ṭi·lū ’eṯ- hak·kê·lîm ’ă·šer bā·’o·nî·yāh ’el- hay·yām lə·hā·qêl mê·‘ă·lê·hem wə·yō·w·nāh yā·raḏ ’el- yar·kə·ṯê has·sə·p̄î·nāh way·yiš·kaḇ way·yê·rā·ḏam
verses.literal: The sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god And they threw the ship’s cargo into the sea to lighten the load But Jonah had gone down to the lowest part of the vessel where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep
verses.literalPt: Então, os marinheiros tiveram medo, e clamavam cada um ao seu deus, e alijaram ao mar a carga que estava no navio, para o aliviarem. Jonas, porém, tinha descido ao interior do navio; e, tendo-se deitado, dormia um profundo sono.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרַ֤ב אֵלָיו֙ רַ֣ב הַחֹבֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ מַה־ לְּךָ֣ נִרְדָּ֑ם ק֚וּם קְרָ֣א אֶל־ אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אוּלַ֞י יִתְעַשֵּׁ֧ת הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים לָ֖נוּ וְלֹ֥א נֹאבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·raḇ ’ê·lāw raḇ ha·ḥō·ḇêl way·yō·mer lōw mah- lə·ḵā nir·dām qūm qə·rā ’el- ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ū·lay yiṯ·‘aš·šêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·nū wə·lō nō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: The captain . . . approached him and said How can you sleep Get up and call upon your God Perhaps this God will consider us so that we may not perish
verses.literalPt: Chegou-se a ele o piloto e disse-lhe: Que estás fazendo, ó tu que dormes? Levanta-te, clama ao teu Deus, a ver se, acaso, Deus se lembrará de nós, para que não pereçamos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֗הוּ לְכוּ֙ וְנַפִּ֣ילָה גֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וְנֵ֣דְעָ֔ה בְּשֶׁלְּמִ֛י הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לָ֑נוּ וַיַּפִּ֙לוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַיִּפֹּ֥ל הַגּוֹרָ֖ל עַל־ יוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’îš ’el- rê·‘ê·hū lə·ḵū wə·nap·pî·lāh ḡō·w·rā·lō·wṯ wə·nê·ḏə·‘āh bə·šel·lə·mî hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ lā·nū way·yap·pi·lū gō·w·rā·lō·wṯ way·yip·pōl hag·gō·w·rāl ‘al- yō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Come said the sailors to one another Let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity that is upon us So they cast lots and the lot fell on Jonah
verses.literalPt: Disseram uns aos outros: Vinde, e deitemos sortes, para sabermos por causa de quem nos acontece este mal. Deitaram, pois, sortes, e a sorte caiu sobre Jonas.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו הַגִּידָה־ נָּ֣א לָ֔נוּ בַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר לְמִי־ הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לָ֑נוּ מַה־ מְּלַאכְתְּךָ֙ וּמֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֔וֹא מָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֔ךָ וְאֵֽי־ מִזֶּ֥ה עַ֖ם אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw hag·gî·ḏāh- nā lā·nū ba·’ă·šer lə·mî- hā·rā·‘āh haz·zōṯ lā·nū mah- mə·laḵ·tə·ḵā ū·mê·’a·yin tā·ḇō·w māh ’ar·ṣe·ḵā wə·’ê- miz·zeh ‘am ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: Tell us now they demanded who is to blame for this calamity that is upon us What is your occupation and where have you come from What is your country and who . . . are your people
verses.literalPt: Então, lhe disseram: Dize-nos: por causa de quem nos acontece este mal. Qual é a tua ocupação? Donde vens? Qual é a tua terra? E de que povo és?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עִבְרִ֣י אָנֹ֑כִי וְאֶת־ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֲנִ֣י יָרֵ֔א אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם וְאֶת־ הַיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ‘iḇ·rî ’ā·nō·ḵî wə·’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê haš·šā·ma·yim ’ă·nî yā·rê ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- hay·yām wə·’eṯ- hay·yab·bā·šāh
verses.literal: I am a Hebrew replied Jonah . . . I worship the LORD the God of the heavens who made the sea and the dry land
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes ele: Eu sou hebreu e temo a Jeová, Deus do céu, que fez o mar e a terra.

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ יִרְאָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו מַה־ זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֑יתָ כִּֽי־ יָדְע֣וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּֽי־ מִלִּפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא בֹרֵ֔חַ כִּ֥י הִגִּ֖יד לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rə·’ū hā·’ă·nā·šîm yir·’āh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw mah- zōṯ ‘ā·śî·ṯā kî- yā·ḏə·‘ū hā·’ă·nā·šîm kî- mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh hū ḇō·rê·aḥ kî hig·gîḏ lā·hem
verses.literal: Then the men were even more afraid . . . and said to him What have you done The men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the LORD because he had told them
verses.literalPt: Então, os homens ficaram possuídos de grande medo e lhe disseram: Que é isso que fizeste? Pois os homens souberam que ele fugia da presença de Jeová, porque lho havia dito.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ מַה־ נַּ֣עֲשֶׂה לָּ֔ךְ וְיִשְׁתֹּ֥ק הַיָּ֖ם מֵֽעָלֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֥י הַיָּ֖ם הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וְסֹעֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw mah- na·‘ă·śeh lāḵ wə·yiš·tōq hay·yām mê·‘ā·lê·nū kî hay·yām hō·w·lêḵ wə·sō·‘êr
verses.literal: Now the sea was growing worse and worse so they said to Jonah What must we do to you to calm this sea for us
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe: Que te faremos nós, para que o mar cesse de se levantar contra nós? Pois o mar se ia tornando cada vez mais tempestuoso.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם שָׂא֙וּנִי֙ וַהֲטִילֻ֣נִי אֶל־ הַיָּ֔ם וְיִשְׁתֹּ֥ק הַיָּ֖ם מֵֽעֲלֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יוֹדֵ֣עַ אָ֔נִי כִּ֣י בְשֶׁלִּ֔י הַסַּ֧עַר הַגָּד֛וֹל הַזֶּ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem śā·’ū·nî wa·hă·ṭî·lu·nî ’el- hay·yām wə·yiš·tōq hay·yām mê·‘ă·lê·ḵem kî yō·w·ḏê·a‘ ’ā·nî kî ḇə·šel·lî has·sa·‘ar hag·gā·ḏō·wl haz·zeh ‘ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: Pick me up he answered and cast me into the sea so it may quiet down for you For I know that I am to blame for this violent storm that has come upon you
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes: Levantai-me e lançai-me no mar; assim, cessará o mar de se levantar contra vós, porque eu sei que é por minha causa que vos sobreveio esta grande tempestade.

verses.original: וַיַּחְתְּר֣וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים לְהָשִׁ֛יב אֶל־ הַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה וְלֹ֣א יָכֹ֑לוּ כִּ֣י הַיָּ֔ם הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וְסֹעֵ֖ר עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·tə·rū hā·’ă·nā·šîm lə·hā·šîḇ ’el- hay·yab·bā·šāh wə·lō yā·ḵō·lū kî hay·yām hō·w·lêḵ wə·sō·‘êr ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Nevertheless, the men rowed hard to get back to dry land but they could not for the sea was raging against them more and more
verses.literalPt: Todavia, os homens se esforçavam com os remos para tornar a ganhar a terra; porém não podiam, pois o mar se ia tornando cada vez mais tempestuoso contra eles.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֨וּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אָנָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אַל־ נָ֣א נֹאבְדָ֗ה בְּנֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַל־ תִּתֵּ֥ן עָלֵ֖ינוּ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑יא כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָפַ֖צְתָּ עָשִֽׂיתָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·’ū ’el- Yah·weh way·yō·mə·rū ’ān·nāh Yah·weh ’al- nā nō·ḇə·ḏāh bə·ne·p̄eš hā·’îš haz·zeh wə·’al- tit·tên ‘ā·lê·nū dām nā·qî kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer ḥā·p̄aṣ·tā ‘ā·śî·ṯā
verses.literal: So they cried out to the LORD . . . Please O LORD do not . . . let us perish on account of this man’s life Do not charge us with innocent blood For You O LORD have done as You pleased
verses.literalPt: Por isso, clamaram a Jeová e disseram: Rogamos-te, Jeová, que não pereçamos por causa da vida deste homem e que não faças cair sobre nós o sangue inocente; pois tu, Jeová, fizeste como foi do teu agrado.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־ יוֹנָ֔ה וַיְטִלֻ֖הוּ אֶל־ הַיָּ֑ם וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד הַיָּ֖ם מִזַּעְפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- yō·w·nāh way·ṭi·lu·hū ’el- hay·yām way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ hay·yām miz·za‘·pōw
verses.literal: Then they picked up Jonah and cast him into the sea and the raging sea grew calm
verses.literalPt: Levantaram, pois, a Jonas e lançaram-no ao mar; e o mar cessou da sua fúria.

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֧וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֛ים יִרְאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּֽזְבְּחוּ־ זֶ֙בַח֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַֽיִּדְּר֖וּ נְדָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rə·’ū hā·’ă·nā·šîm yir·’āh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·yiz·bə·ḥū- ze·ḇaḥ Yah·weh way·yid·də·rū nə·ḏā·rîm
verses.literal: Then the men . . . feared the LORD greatly and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows to Him
verses.literalPt: Então, os homens temeram em extremo a Jeová; ofereceram sacrifícios a Jeová e fizeram votos.

verses.original: וַיְמַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ דָּ֣ג גָּד֔וֹל לִבְלֹ֖עַ אֶת־ יוֹנָ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י יוֹנָה֙ בִּמְעֵ֣י הַדָּ֔ג שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יָמִ֖ים וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה לֵילֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·man Yah·weh dāḡ gā·ḏō·wl liḇ·lō·a‘ ’eṯ- yō·w·nāh way·hî yō·w·nāh bim·‘ê had·dāḡ šə·lō·šāh yā·mîm ū·šə·lō·šāh lê·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Now the LORD had appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah and Jonah spent three days and three nights in the belly of the fish
verses.literalPt: Jeová preparou um grande peixe que tragasse a Jonas, e Jonas esteve no ventre do peixe três dias e três noites.
